summary: B9 (WARP-0309, suite catalog and gate-slot wiring) is correct and honest, closing PLAN-0003 at 20/20. Independent adversarial review: clean PASS, gate GREEN (selftest 578), the catalog covers all runner directories with statuses that EQUAL capabilities.yaml (both copies byte-identical), each row states a gate slot and fixture pair. BJ1 proven NON-TAUTOLOGICAL two independent ways: renaming a runner's failing fixture makes scripts/check_runner_catalog.py exit 1 naming it, and deleting a runner's capabilities line turns the real unit-slot selftest RED, both restored. BJ2 confirmed: ten surface-requiring gate slots are declared na with reasons in verify.sh and no required gate command shells a runner (asserted mechanically, exercised against the real verify.sh and a synthetic shelling one). Generic, ASCII, no double-hyphen, stdlib-only. proof_digest recomputed via validate.py.
